domina.maps_summary:
Domina
 performs best on maps with strong choke points and long hallways, such as Havana, Junkertown, and Midtown.

tracer.maps_summary: Tracer’s mobility allows her to find value on virtually every map.

vendetta.maps_summary:
Vendetta
 is an versitile hero who can adapt her playstyle to most maps.

sojourn.maps_summary: Sojourn’s versatility allows her to be played effectively on every map.

kiriko.maps_summary:
Kiriko
's mobility and versatility make her a solid choice on every map.

dva.maps_summary:
The most distinct advantage 
D.Va
 has over the rest of the Tanks is her ability to fly for 2 seconds, every 3 and a half seconds.

winston.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Winston
 have structures, high ground, and plenty of natural cover.

roadhog.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Roadhog
 are those that encourage close-range fights, like most Control and Flashpoint maps.

emre.maps_summary: Emre performs best on maps with objective areas and sightlines that match his optimal range (e.g., Rialto, Nepal, Esperança).

echo.maps_summary: Echo’s quick movement and flying abilities are best utilized on maps with plenty of high ground and natural vertical cover.

symmetra.maps_summary:
The best maps to play 
Symmetra
 on either have enclosed objective areas or funnel both teams into one main choke point.

soldier-76.maps_summary: The best maps to play Soldier: 76 on are maps with lots of flank routes.

mizuki.maps_summary: Maps that encourage close-range or brawly fights are the best for Mizuki to make full use of his kit (e.g., Oasis, Samoa, King's Row).

wuyang.maps_summary:
Wuyang
 has good horizontal and vertical mobility, long-range damage, and medium-range healing.

hazard.maps_summary:
Hazard
's mobility is best utilized on maps with lots of walls to climb, and plenty of high ground to move around on.

junker-queen.maps_summary:
Maps with primarily flat areas around the objective are the best for 
Junker Queen
.

mauga.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Mauga
 have small but open objective areas.

orisa.maps_summary:
Orisa
 is always going to be a good choice on maps that favor poke comps.

doomfist.maps_summary:
Doomfist
 and his incredible mobility are best utilized on maps where teams tend to play spread out.

anran.maps_summary:
On Control and Flashpointmaps (e.g., Nepal, Lijiang Tower, Suravasa), 
Anran
 thrives by leveraging verticality and flank routes to harass isolated enemies and secure early picks.

freja.maps_summary: The best maps for Freja complement her medium-long range positioning.

hanzo.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Hanzo
 have open long and narrow sightlines lines like Circuit Royal, first point Colosseo, and Havana.

junkrat.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Junkrat
 have narrow corridors small objective areas and some high ground to play around.

reaper.maps_summary: Reaper thrives on maps with tight spaces and lots of small rooms.

mei.maps_summary:
Mei
 tends to have an easier time finding value on non-payload maps.

widowmaker.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Widowmaker
 have long-sight lines where she can take advantage of her superior range.

torbjorn.maps_summary: Torbjörn and his Turrets do best on maps that favor close-range engagements and have choke points that are difficult to break through.

juno.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Juno
 are flat, have a lot of open space, and encourage fights to be on the objective.

mercy.maps_summary:
Mercy
's best maps have lots of space for her to move around.

zenyatta.maps_summary:
The best maps for 
Zenyatta
 allow him to abuse his superior ranged poke damage.

wrecking-ball.maps_summary:
Because 
Wrecking Ball
 can use 
Grappling Claw
 and 
Roll
 to move both vertically and horizontally, he performs well on maps with high ground as well as flatter layouts.

ramattra.maps_summary: Maps that favor close-range engagements, have smaller objective areas, and little to no high ground are best for Ram.

sombra.maps_summary: The best maps for Sombra have lots of side rooms for her to set up in.

lifeweaver.maps_summary:
The main feature 
Lifeweaver
 wants in a map is natural cover.
